deviations.what: M2 per-hop redirect policy enforcement is post-hoc, not in-line: the adapter checks policy pre-navigation and the service re-evaluates every returned hop (denying results that traversed a denied hop, with an unrevalidated-redirects degraded-evidence warning), but the browser may contact an intermediate redirect target before denial — Playwright route interception is not re-invoked for auto-followed redirects, so in-line blocking would have silently failed open; true in-line enforcement needs a policy-enforcing local proxy
deviations.reason: probe during t11: Playwright fires route handlers once per navigation, not per redirect hop — interception-based enforcement fails open, so the safer post-hoc containment shape was shipped instead
